___ y M with complicated PMH including multiple prior strokes, 
resulting seizure disorder and R-sided hemiplegia, CAD, T2DM who 
presents after episode of projectile vomiting.

Per wife, the 
episode was very large volume brown fluid.

No coffee ground, no 
blood, did not resemble his tube feeds.

He has been groaning 
more during tube feeds, and prior to vomiting was holding his 
stomach.
Had a large, formed BM yesterday.

No fevers, no other 
changes in behavior.

No hx of prior 
abdominal surgery.

Has tolerated smaller tube feeds and 
medications since then.
In the ED, initial vitals were: 97.2 65 151/80 18 100%

- Imaging unremarkable for any acute process (CXR, CT head, CT 
abd, G-tube study)
- The patient was given ceftriaxone x1.

Had fem line placed due 
to access issues.
Vitals prior to transfer were: 98.7 60 108/65 15 98% RA

Upon arrival to the floor, pt without clear focal discomfort but 
reports by nursing of gagging appearance.

- Stroke most recently ___ - CT demonstrated evolving
encephalomalacia in the left hemisphere today

- Seizure disorder with EEG demonstrating Left temporal
epileptiform activity as well as status epilepticus during ___
admission.

- Stroke, ___, presented with numbness around lips and on  
nose, reports that MRI at ___ showed stroke.
- PVD s/p Aorto to R subclavian and RCA bypass
- Central retinal artery occlusion right eye ___

- Multiple Myocardial Infarctions (brother died at age ___, 
father died at age ___, several paternal uncles died in their

General: Alert and able to track but non-communicative, limited 
ability to follow commands
HEENT: Sclera anicteric, MMM, oropharynx clear, EOMI, PERRL
CV: RRR, normal S1 + S2, no murmurs, rubs, gallops
Lungs: CBAT, no wheezes, rales, rhonchi

GU: Foley in place, femoral line in place

LUNGS: CBAT, no wheezes, rales, rhonchi

No evidence of deep vein thrombosis in the right upper 
extremity.
2. Gastrostomy tube terminating just beyond the pylorus.

No evidence of leak or

1. No acute intracranial pathology or significant change.

2. Extensive encephalomalacia throughout the left cerebral 
hemisphere and left cerebellum, consistent with remote 
infarction.

___ y non communicative man with a complicated PMH including 
multiple prior strokes, resulting seizure disorder and R-sided 
hemiplegia, CAD, T2DM who presents after episode of projectile 
vomiting w/ fever.

Patient presented with fever and vomitting initially concerning 
for abdominal source or malfunctioning of G-tube.

Patient had 
extensive abdominal imaging that did not show intrabdominal 
abnormality and also showed functioning G-tube.

Tube feeds were 
transiently stopped and then slowly re-introduced.

Patient did 
not have further recurrence of vomitting or fever.

Patient with prior history of aspiration pneumonia for which 
broad spectrum coverage with IV ceftriaxone and IV flagyl was 
initiated.

Patient was transitioned to augmentin and treated for 
total 7 day course that ended on ___.

Patient noted to be hypotensive with SBP of 70 during this 
hospitalization.

Ultimately patient was given 3L IVF with 
improvement of blood pressure.

It was later noted in discussion 
with patient's wife that blood pressure on left upper extremity 
usually inaccurate and does not register and that blood pressure 
on right upper extremity was more accurate.

Blood pressure was 
measured on right upper extremity throughout the remainder of 
hospitalization and was normal.

Patient with upper and lower extremity edema this 
hospitalization in the setting of IVF administration and poor 
mobilization of fluid given patient's bed bound status.

BNP and upper extremity US was further obtained that were all 
within normal limits.

Extremity edema was much improved at time 
of discharge.

Additionally patient had seizures about twice per day consisting 
of left face, arm, and leg twitching/movement.

Per patient's 
wife these seizures were consistent with patient's baseline of 
one of these episodes per day.

Patient was on 4 antiepileptics 
with appropriate serum levels.

It was felt that his more 
frequent seizure were likely secondary to underlying aspiration 
pneumonia.

Per discussion with neurology consultants and 
patient's wife it was determined that additional agent like 
ativan would not be used as patient became very somnolent with 
minimal interaction with these unless patient had whole body 
convulsions which did not occur.

Mr. ___ was also noted to have anemia consistent with his 
baseline Hg of 11.3.

Additionally patient was noted to be 
thrombocytopenic in setting of acute illness.

Heparin induced 
thrombocytopenia was strongly considered given IV heparin 
flushes and high 4T score.

Patient was started on IV argatroban 
but heparin dependent antibodies returned negative and 
argatroban discontinued and platelets recovered to 215 prior to 
discharge.

For patient's atrial fibrillation INR was 1.6 prior to discharge 
for which lovenox bridge was started to continue until INR 
therapeutic within range of ___.

Lovenox 80 mg SC twice daily 
should be continued with warfarin until INR is therapeutic in 
range of ___ for greater than 24 hours at which point lovenox 
can be stopped.

Patient was rate controlled with carvedilol 
twice daily.

INR should be checked daily to ensure it stays 
within goal of ___ and warfarin adjusted accordingly.
Patient followed by palliative care over long period of time.

During this hospitalization patient's wife voiced that patient 
was DNR/DNI and that she would like for him to pass naturally 
when the time comes.

She did not however feel comfortable 
signing MOLST form to verify this given her strong religious 
beliefs.
The Preadmission Medication list is accurate and complete.
14. Milk of Magnesia 30 mL PO Q6H:PRN constipation
19. Artificial Tears ___ DROP BOTH EYES PRN dry eyes
20. Acetaminophen 325-650 mg PO Q6H:PRN pain, fever
Level of Consciousness: Lethargic but arousable.
1. No acute intracranial pathology or significant change.
2. Extensive encephalomalacia throughout the left cerebral hemisphere and left cerebellum, consistent with remote infarction.
2. Gastrostomy tube terminating just beyond the pylorus.
No evidence of deep vein thrombosis in the right upper extremity.
Tubefeeding Order: 1 order(s) before T_pa; first on hospital day 1, most recent 145.4 h before T_pa.
Physical Therapy: 1 order(s) before T_pa; first on hospital day 1, most recent 153.8 h before T_pa.
